js: 'SETUP: a dev instance whose database has a decision row decide/laya (backend cpu; labs-store design section 4), its container_prefix set to lmgw-dev3, started with LMGW_DATA_DIR=<scratch> scripts/dev-instance.sh 127.0.0.1:8899, then seeded with scripts/agent-decide-seed.py http://127.0.0.1:8899 <token> <scratch>/lmgw.sqlite: the question set drive triage (a choice of the mail categories, its 0.7 not measured) and a finished mail-labeler apply job whose rows that set classified, each stamped with it: 18f1 Finance, 18f2 Newsletter, 18f3 never asked (its fetch failed), 18f4 whose call failed. Run: scripts/ui-drive.py scripts/drive/agent-decide.json --token-file <scratch>.token --podman-guard "" --shots <dir>. It makes a second set (drive upset, whose category question is a noul) and checks the mail labeler config form: the Question set select with none and both sets, the categories note once a set is picked, Save config, the threshold line saying the 0.7 is not measured so not applied, the problem line of the noul set. Then it opens the apply run, sees the attention group say the threshold is not applied, saves the run as a labelled set into the set its rows name and follows its link to the set-run page; last it deletes that set run and both sets and empties the field again, checking each delete. Nothing asks a model. Seed again before the next run.'

expect: (async()=>{const h={'content-type':'application/json'};const l=await (await fetch('/labs/api/decision/presets?kind=question_set')).json();if(!l.presets.some(p=>p.name==='drive triage'))return false;for(const p of l.presets){if(p.name==='drive upset'){const r=await fetch('/labs/api/decision/presets/'+p.id+'/delete',{method:'POST',headers:h,body:'null'});if(r.status!==200)return false}}for(const b of (await (await fetch('/decision-lab/api/batches')).json()).batches){if(b.source_name.endsWith(' of mail-labeler')){const r=await fetch('/decision-lab/api/batches/'+b.id+'/delete',{method:'POST',headers:h,body:'null'});if(r.status!==200)return false}}const r=await fetch('/labs/api/decision/presets',{method:'POST',headers:h,body:JSON.stringify({name:'drive upset',kind:'question_set',body:{questions:[{id:'category',instructions:'Which category is this mail?',kind:{type:'noul',yes:'',no:''}}],default_model:'decide/laya',thresholds:{}}})});const c=await fetch('/api/op/agent_config_set',{method:'POST',headers:h,body:JSON.stringify({id:'mail-labeler',values:{decision_set:null}})});return r.status===200 && c.status===200})()
label: setup: the seeded set drive triage is there, drive upset is made, the field is empty

expect: document.querySelector('#qs-row .fr-label').textContent.includes('question set') && document.querySelector('#qs-btn').textContent.includes('none · classify with the model')
label: the Question set field is a select reading none, classify with the model
its help links to the Decision lab, where sets are made
without a set, neither the categories nor the set field carries a note

expect: (()=>{const o=[...document.querySelectorAll('.select-pop .select-opt')].map(e=>e.textContent.trim());return o[0]==='none · classify with the model' && o.includes('drive triage · decide/laya') && o.includes('drive upset · decide/laya')})()
label: the select lists none first, then the owner's sets with their models
picking a set shows it in the select

expect: (()=>{const t=(document.querySelector('#cat-row .fr-help .notice.warn')||{textContent:''}).textContent;return t.startsWith('Not read while a question set is chosen: the set') && t.includes('choice question') && t.includes('category') && t.endsWith('gives the categories.')})()
label: the categories field says it is not read while a set is chosen
the pick is one unsaved field
after Save config and a reload the set is stored, and the categories note stays

expect: [...document.querySelectorAll('#qs-row .fr-help .dim')].some(e=>e.textContent==="The set's threshold for 'category' is 0.7, not measured: not applied. A row needs attention on the fallback or when its call failed.")
label: the set field says the set's 0.7 is not measured, so not applied

expect: (()=>{const row=[...document.querySelectorAll('.fr-label')].find(e=>e.textContent.startsWith('Question set')).parentElement;const n=row.querySelector('.fr-help .notice.err');return n!==null && n.textContent.includes('as a noul question') && n.textContent.includes('choice question')})()
label: a stored set whose question is no choice says why it cannot classify
the last run is the apply run

expect: [...document.querySelectorAll('.review-table tr.group')].some(e=>e.textContent.includes("the fallback or a failed call (the set's threshold of 0.7 is not measured, so not applied) — check them, or change the set or its threshold and re-run these"))
label: the attention group says the unmeasured threshold is not applied, and that the set is the way out

expect: (()=>{const t=document.querySelector('.action-bar .action-note a[href^="/decision-lab/batches/"]').parentElement.textContent;return /^Saved as set run #\d+ of 'drive triage' · 2 items on decide\/laya, 2 labelled · not run yet · left out: 1 row the model never saw \(18f3\), 1 row whose call failed \(18f4\) · Open it$/.test(t)})()
label: the save names the set its rows name, what the set run holds and the rows left out by kind

expect: (async()=>{const a=document.querySelector('.action-bar .action-note a[href^="/decision-lab/batches/"]');const id=a.getAttribute('href').split('/').pop();const v=await (await fetch('/decision-lab/api/batches/'+id)).json();const it=await (await fetch('/decision-lab/api/batches/'+id+'/items')).json();return v.status==='not_started' && v.job_id===null && v.total===2 && v.labelled===2 && v.source_name.startsWith('agent run ') && v.source_name.endsWith(' of mail-labeler') && v.preset_name==='drive triage' && v.set.questions.length===1 && it.items[0].item.key==='18f1' && it.items[0].item.expected.category==='Finance' && it.items[1].item.expected.category==='Newsletter' && it.items[0].form.state.startsWith('From: billing@shop.example') && it.items[0].form.questions.map(q=>q.id).join()==='category'})()
label: the set run is not started, holds the two asked rows with the reviewed labels and their prompts, asking the category question alone
the link opens the set run's page

expect: (async()=>{const h={'content-type':'application/json'};const st=[];for(const b of (await (await fetch('/decision-lab/api/batches')).json()).batches){if(b.source_name.endsWith(' of mail-labeler')){st.push((await fetch('/decision-lab/api/batches/'+b.id+'/delete',{method:'POST',headers:h,body:'null'})).status)}}const l=await (await fetch('/labs/api/decision/presets?kind=question_set')).json();for(const p of l.presets){if(p.name==='drive triage'||p.name==='drive upset'){st.push((await fetch('/labs/api/decision/presets/'+p.id+'/delete',{method:'POST',headers:h,body:'null'})).status)}}st.push((await fetch('/api/op/agent_config_set',{method:'POST',headers:h,body:JSON.stringify({id:'mail-labeler',values:{decision_set:null}})})).status);const left=(await (await fetch('/labs/api/decision/presets?kind=question_set')).json()).presets.filter(p=>p.name.startsWith('drive ')).length;return st.length===4 && st.every(s=>s===200) && left===0})()
label: cleanup: the saved set run, both sets and the field are gone again, every delete answered 200
